result_text:
The landscape contributor lists are no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed the `.limit(limit)` call and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. That class builds every contributor table (all, recent, bots, teams), so they now list everyone in the same order as before.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`:** I removed the `.limit(...)` in the recent-commits bar chart, so it draws one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration`, but nothing in `reports` reads it any more.
